Photos are subject to size and restrictions and must meet passport requirements. Passport quality photos can be taken in the County Clerk’s Office for a fee of $10.00. The passport fee for the age of 16 years and older is $130.00 to the U.S. Dept. of State and $35.00 to the Sanilac County Register of Deeds. The $130.00 fee paid to the U.S. Depart. of State MUST be a check or money order. Bring your checkbook with you. Expedited and postal express services are available at extra charges. Passport for under the age of 16 years: To apply the child must be present, submit a certified copy of birth certificate, a photo taken within the last 6 months and have both parents appear at the time of application with a valid driver’s license or personal identification. If the second parent is not available to sign, the appearing parent must present evidence that they have sole legal custody of the child or written consent of the other parent for the issuance of the passport or a written statement explaining why the non-applying parent’s consent cannot be obtained. Photos are subject to size and restrictions and must meet passport requirements. Passport quality photos can be taken in the County Clerk’s Office for a fee of $10.00. The fee is $100.00 to the U.S. Dept. of State and $35.00 to the Sanilac County Register of Deeds. The $100.00 fee to the U.S. Dept. of State MUST be paid with a check or money order. Bring your checkbook with you. Expedited and postal express services are available at extra charges. Sanilac County Register of Deeds – Office Hours are: 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., closed for lunch 12:00 to 1:00 pm. Monday through Friday at the Courthouse, 2nd Floor, Register of Deeds Office, 60 W. Sanilac Ave., Sandusky, MI., and Phone Number – 810-648-2313.
